scripts.dev: (cd apps/server && APP_ENV=development CGO_ENABLED=0 go run .) & pnpm --filter @path-finder/web dev; wait
scripts.lint:server: cd apps/server && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)" && CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet ./...
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:server
scripts.check:web: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:e2e
